claims.claim_text: Architected a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows, establishing L0 route-policy dispatch and runtime proof-bundle lineage as the control-plane foundation for production agentic delivery.
Built CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, translating partner and customer deal support into repeatable, revenue-linked adoption pathways.
Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by instituting evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls across the production agent runtime.
Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through monitoring, compressing lab-to-production cycle time from six months to three weeks while preserving deterministic auditability.

Architected distributed cloud data runtime integration patterns across Databricks Lakehouse, vector services, and API gateways, applying dense sparse exact retrieval design and provider egress governance.
Converted bespoke delivery into commercialized platform IP while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28, building the operating model behind reusable agentic AI capability.
